title: GTA 6 is getting a 34-song original soundtrack, with music from multiple real-world artists - and you can stream six tracks today
summary: Rockstar has revealed a handful of tracks that are part of the Grand Theft Auto 6 original soundtrack.

Image credit: Rockstar Games, Take-Two. News by Sherif Saed Senior Contributor Published on Sept. 17, 2026, 12:57 p.m. 24 comments Follow Grand Theft Auto VI Prioritise us on Google Grand Theft Auto 6 's original soundtrack was partially revealed today. The full album contains 34 original tracks made for the upcoming open-world crime game. The majority of tracks remain mysterious, with their titles simply listing their number on the album. However, Rockstar unveiled just six of them today, and they're available to listen to now. Here's the list of what you can listen to today: Yung Lean - That's It (feat. Future & Metro Boomin) Travis Scott - RHYNO (prod. by Guy-Manuel de Homem-Christo) CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, PinkPantheress, Fred again.. & Etienne de Crécy - Sexy Magic Morgan Wallen - Last Thing You Need Rauw Alejandro - Macacoa 2000 Keith Richards - Bright Lights, Big City Grand Theft Auto 6: The Album is available 19th November alongside GTA 6. It can be acquired on vinyl and CD, alongside availability on multiple music streaming services. Physical versions of the album are up for pre-order , priced $20 / £11 for the CD version and $50 / £45 for the vinyl. A limited edition vinyl with custom artwork is also available for $125 / £109 - though it has already sold out on the UK site. Image credit: Rockstar Games, Take-Two. You can pre-save the album to your account on Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music, Deezer, Tidal and Amazon Music to be notified when the full thing goes live. The same link also lets you listen to the six sample tracks. Today's reveal follows a string of teasers from the featured artists, who shared GTA 6-stylised posters on various social media platforms. More recently, one of the game's cast of actors has been confirmed as King of the Hill's Stephen Root . GTA 6 launches 19th November on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S.
